reviews.text: The best around for doggy daycare! My dog doesn’t look back once we get inside the gate - he’s dying to go straight in to his buddies and always comes home delighted with himself!

I sent my very friendly dog to this day care and after awhile we noticed he began getting aggressive towards other dogs, and one day after collecting him one of the owners between laughs informed me that in awhile back he got attacked/humped by a none neutered dog (none neutered dogs shouldn’t even be aloud in this setting) and that he would no longer be aloud to return while the other dog who attacked/humped him could remain. We didn’t even an apology for letting this happen and ever since he has been behavioral problems. I do not recommend.
The most fantastic doggy day care in the world ! It's like a home from home for our dogs ! Such lovely people
